{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies net_processing.cpp to replace an assertion with fatal error handling and handles block I/O errors during peer request processing",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents ungraceful assertion aborts during GETBLOCKTXN handling when disk reads fail and avoids silently dropping peer requests. While it fixes crash and silent-drop bugs in message handling, it addresses rare underlying filesystem failure scenarios rather than typical protocol operation."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to test utilities and functional test runners only serve the validation and P2P I/O error test suites rather than general test infrastructure",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The PR does not belong to test infrastructure because the test modifications directly pin block storage and P2P error handling behavior rather than introducing general framework capabilities."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled Validation, modifies FlatFileSeq block storage error handling and addresses failure handling in ActivateBestChain",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents the node from getting silently stuck when block storage encounters filesystem errors during chain activation. Without this, FlatFileSeq::Open throws an exception that bypasses FatalError in ActivateBestChain and gets swallowed by net_processing, compromising crash safety and clean shutdown."
    }
  ],

  }
